title: Maximize the Topmost Element After K Moves
goal: Maximize the stack top after exactly k remove-or-restore moves.
strategy: A final restored item can come from the first k-1 removals, while removing exactly k original items exposes index k. A singleton is special because its stack alternates between empty and occupied.

edgeCases: Zero moves preserves the original top
An odd number of moves empties a singleton stack
More moves than items can still restore the largest value
